about: The AI-text detector's 75 inputs (x, model input order), probability (p) and verdict on paragraphs of 15 consecutive sentences of grammar_clean_court.txt (CC0) and the paragraphs of ai_detector_canary_texts.txt, alone and in fours, computed by the Rust implementation, and a fingerprint of the lexicon word sets it reads. A drift canary (style::ai_detector::tests::inputs_match_drift_canary), not training-code parity: history records each deliberate input change.
history: created at be3f4be: the detector's inputs as the review-3 baseline (they moved on 55 % of review 3's 1,928-text sample since training; 0 verdict changes, max |Δp| 0.034; retrain pending)

review 3 phase I: tokenizer, segmenter, analyzer edges, lexicon and ranking (one baseline before spec 1.0) (inputs moved on 12 of 100 texts, max |Δp| 1.07e-3, 0 verdicts changed; lexicon word sets changed: true)

review 3 phase M: abbreviation readings and lexicon additions (the last baseline before spec 1.0) (inputs moved on 0 of 100 texts, max |Δp| 1.08e-19, 0 verdicts changed; lexicon word sets changed: true)

review 4 phase N2: tokenizer (initials, NFD, dates), segmenter (redactions, acronyms, Roman ordinals), terms and lexicon twins, before spec 1.0 (inputs moved on 16 of 100 texts, max |Δp| 1.19e-3, 0 verdicts changed; lexicon word sets changed: true)

review 4 phase N4: 48 paragraphs of the shapes court text lacks join the canary, alone and in 12 groups of four (DOWN4-05); no input of the court paragraphs moved (inputs moved on 60 of 160 texts, max |Δp| 1.08e-19, 0 verdicts changed; lexicon word sets changed: false)

review 4 follow-up O1: 190 given names and surnames of akana's PII lists join the lexicon, six corpus company words leave it, md/mad/Av/Sok/San read as their word (inputs moved on 0 of 160 texts, max |Δp| 1.11e-16, 0 verdicts changed; lexicon word sets changed: true)

pre-release audit P1: 37 given names and surnames join the lexicon (PII's COMMON_SURNAMES and court-decision names), İth/İhr added, and 14 abbreviations of companies, titles and addresses read as their word (inputs moved on 0 of 160 texts, max |Δp| 1.11e-16, 0 verdicts changed; lexicon word sets changed: true)
pre-release audit P2: 15 surnames of court decisions and Tahran, Allan, Copa join the lexicon (inputs moved on 0 of 160 texts, max |Δp| 1.11e-16, 0 verdicts changed; lexicon word sets changed: true)

pre-release review: abbreviations read as their word keep their own spelling (a word in lower case is no abbreviation again: av, aş); Bilin and Edin are no surnames (inputs moved on 0 of 160 texts, max |Δp| 1.11e-16, 0 verdicts changed; lexicon word sets changed: true)
